title: CGUSB-ST4 / NYX-101 ST4 DEC response is inverted relative to direct NYX guiding away from pole on both pier sides.
summary: At DEC +70 and R1, adapter 0 moves south and 1 north on both E and W; repeated direct NYX n/s controls have expected signs. E: about -14.552/+14.530 arcsec; W: about -14.539/+14.543 arcsec for 2 s. Next: isolate adapter pin mapping, ST4 cable and NYX configuration/firmware before remediation; owner requires driver mapping unchanged.
evidence: verification.md and orientation-probe.jsonl in task 20261024095945-ac63-verify-cgusbst4-dec-orientation; two repeats each of direct n/s and numeric 0/1, matched idle interval, stable pier side E; original park/settings restored.; W-side follow-up: task 20261024101137-d0d9-verify-cgusbst4-dec-west verification.md and west-orientation-probe.jsonl, two repeats per direction on stable W, MD-approved ordinary goto and exact original park/settings restored.
